reviews.title: DOA & Missing Components
reviews.comment:
Product arrived in unsealed factory packaging, missing all cables, I/O shield, manual driver disc that are all standard with ASUS product delivery.  The board was also wrapped in non-standard (not anti-static bubble wrap).  Missing I/O shield and cables were not an issue, as I had plenty of spares.  Driver disc also not an issue as all drivers were available for download.
However, after having this on our store shelves for a month, went to install the board and it does not even power on.  Having missed the Amazon return window, I ordered an identical replacement board from our bay area vendor, arrived and works perfectly.  I do not believe this was a fault of the motherboard, as I use exclusively ASUS products, have installed over 200 of their boards and have NEVER had a failure.
Please don't wait, like I did, and check all package contents upon arrival and if possible immediately test the product.
reviews.author: Ryan Spaeth

reviews.title: Two fan headers. TWO!
reviews.comment: It's actually not okay to provide only two fan headers. I dare say 90% of modern computers need a minimum of three: front fan, rear fan, and clearly the CPU fan. This board should have included a power supply to fan header adapter at the very least.
